company_profile.description: Trimble Inc. offers technology solutions and platform that enable office professionals and field workers to connect workflows and industry lifecycles in North America, Europe, the Asia Pacific, and internationally. The company provides architecture and interior design; building information modeling, engineering, and virtual design and construction; and construction and owner software products. Further, it offers transportation and logistics solutions for shippers, carriers, retailers, and intermediaries, such as carrier transportation management software (TMS) and maintenance solutions to manage core transportation operations and maintenance workflows; transporeon solutions to provide a cloud-based ecosystem that manages the transportation lifecycle from freight sourcing and procurement through transport execution, dock and yard management, and auditing; and MAPS, a mapping and routing solutions that provide the industry standard for truck-specific routing, mileage, and navigation. It sells its technology solutions directly to end users and through software integrations. The company was formerly known as Trimble Navigation Limited and changed its name to Trimble Inc. in October 2016. Trimble Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Westminster, Colorado.

company_profile.name: TRex Bio, Inc.
company_profile.type_rationale: Standard company — balanced weighting across all methods
company_profile.description: TRex Bio, Inc. develops immunoregulatory biologics for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases in United States and Internationally. The company operates the Deep Biology Platform, a drug discovery and design platform that integrates tissue-level insights into human biology and treg function to identify and characterize therapeutic targets, using computational mapping, which uses in silico tools and a human tissue bank and atlas of human treg gene expression to identify pathways in tissue immune regulation; the Treg Atlas, which recreates tissue states in tregs and reprograms blood-derived Tregs to recreate human tissue-specific pathways in vitro for target validation; and the Phenotypic Assay Cascade, a suite of high-throughput functional fingerprinting assays that test targets across donors and inflammatory contexts. The company develops TRB-061 an investigational tumor necrosis factor receptor 2 (TNFR2) agonist and fragment crystallizable-fusion (Fc-fusion) protein designed to selectively agonize TNFR2 to activate and expand Tregs in inflamed tissues. The company also develops TRB-071, an agonist designed to augment tissue Tregs and block an inflammatory signaling pathway, for inflammatory bowel disease. Additionally, it advances TRB-051, a partnered modulator of immune effector cells, for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases including lupus with cutaneous involvement. The company also advances preclinical-stage programs addressing tissue Treg biology informed by the Deep Biology Platform. TRex Bio, Inc. was incorporated in 2018 and is based in South San Francisco, California.

For these companies, that calculation gives a meaningful and trustworthy answer.
